text:
Maya: Idea  Silent Snowball this Friday? Leave a tiny wrapped surprise on a coworker's desk, no names.
Owen: Love that. Low-effort, high delight. Rules? No food with nuts, and nothing messy.
Riley: Can we do a 'theme' for each floor? Tiny socks, stickers, or silly notes?
Samir: I can print 100 small stickers if needed. Also people who prefer not to participate should put a 'no snowball' sticky on their monitor.
Maya: Good call. We'll respect opt-outs. Also budget: keep <$5 per item.
Facilities Bot: FYI: please avoid taping to painted walls. Use the bulletin boards or desk surfaces only.
Tess: I'll make a small sign to put by elevators: "Silent Snowball: Friday 4pm - leave a tiny surprise. Please respect opt-outs."
Callie: Remote folks? Can we include digital snowballs? A Slack DM with a gif counts.
Owen: Yes! Remote: send a DM, tag it with #snowball so we can tally for fun (but still anonymous if you want).
Riley: Quick poll  react with :snowman: if you're in, :x: if opting out, :gift: if you want to help with supplies.
Maya: Also, ideas for non-food trinkets? Tiny notepads, tea sachets, magnetic clips, jokes on index cards.
Samir: I'll bring a box of assorted tiny eco-friendly trinkets and labeled allergy-safe treats.
Tess: Can someone volunteer to collect opt-out names so we don't accidentally gift them?
Maya: I'll keep the list. DM me your opt-out by Thursday noon.
Facilities Bot: Reminder scheduled: Friday 3:45pm - put out a small table in the kitchen for overflow snowballs.
Callie: Love this. Tiny happiness incoming :sparkles:
